name: AudioSegment
description: An independently playable recorded audio chunk with complete source offsets and transcription state

sequence.description: Order of the segment within the session

audio_url.description: Managed storage URL for the audio file

mime_type.description: Audio MIME type such as audio/webm

start_ms.description: Full-session source-relative start time in milliseconds

end_ms.description: Full-session source-relative end time in milliseconds

is_final_segment.description: True for the one latest non-empty segment that carries final capture timing and trailing silence metadata

meaningful_audio_started_ms.description: Full-session source timestamp of meaningful audio when it falls within or informs this segment

meaningful_audio_ended_ms.description: Full-session source timestamp of the last meaningful signal when known for this segment

leading_silence_ms.description: Leading silence duration represented by this segment

trailing_silence_ms.description: Trailing silence duration represented by this segment

clock_source.description: Clock used for this segment: audio-context or best-effort script-processor fallback

transcription_error.description: Safe transcription error shown to staff

transcription_started_at.description: ISO timestamp when the latest transcription attempt began

transcribed_at.description: ISO timestamp when the latest transcription completed

detected_language.description: Primary language value returned by the transcription provider

language_probability.description: Provider primary-language confidence from zero to one

detected_languages.description: De-duplicated language values present in the provider response for this segment, including documented structured or per-word values when supplied

speaker_count.description: Number of provider speaker identities detected

detected_speakers.description: Stable display labels detected in first-seen order

provider_speaker_ids.description: Provider speaker identities in first-seen order

word_count.description: Number of spoken words returned by the provider

provider_text.description: Bounded raw provider transcript text for retry and audit context

pulsar_review_status.description: Optional local Pulsar Review status: not_started, in_progress, or done. Older clips default to not_started in the app.
